ai_summary_zh: 本場區為鋪面道路與人行步道環境，總面積約728.0平方公尺，鋪面狀況良好。場區內共有51棵喬木，平均胸徑(DBH)為20.7公分，並包含18處擋土牆或建築牆面，總垂直面積為196.1平方公尺。場區內無任何水域。
ai_summary_en: The site consists of paved roads and walkways covering approximately 728.0 square meters in good condition. There are 51 urban/park trees with a mean DBH of 20.7 cm at 1.3m, alongside 18 retaining or building wall structures with a total vertical area of 196.1 square meters. There are no water bodies present on the site.
